entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. To better direct your call, please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns'.
Returns! And you better be quick about it, this is ridiculous!
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return this piece of garbage you sent me. Your sizing is a complete joke.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly help with that. To get started, can I have your order number?
It's VF9-887-21. This jersey is completely useless to me. I've been a customer for years and the quality has just gone down the drain. This is unacceptable!
I see the order right here. Thank you, Mr. Evans. I understand your frustration. So I can best help you, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
What do you mean, 'preference'? It's the wrong size! I ordered a Large, and this thing is so tight I can barely breathe in it! It's either mislabeled or you guys don't know how to make clothes.

Okay, I see. Thank you for clarifying that. It sounds like you need a different size. I can definitely help you with an exchange for a larger size, or cannot offer a refund if you'd prefer. Since you received the item just three days ago, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy for apparel.
Don't you try to placate me! I want a refund, and I want it now. This whole experience has been a waste of my time. I want to speak to your manager!

I can certainly process a full refund for you, Mr. Evans, that's no problem at all. My supervisor would give you the exact same solution, as a full refund is our standard policy for a situation like this. I can start that process and email you a pre-paid return label right now.
Fine. But if I don't see that email in the next two minutes, I'm lighting you up on every review site on the internet. You think I'm kidding?

I understand completely. I am processing the return authorization now. I've just sent the email with the shipping label to the address on file. You should see it momentarily. Once we receive the jersey, the refund will be issued back to your original payment method. Would you prefer to do an exchange for the next size up instead?
No! I'm done with your company's terrible sizing. Just give me my money back. ... Hold on, I see the email. It's here.
Excellent. Just print that label, attach it to the package, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No. That's all. Just make sure the refund goes through properly.
I will personally monitor it to ensure it does. Thank you for your call, and I do apologize again for the inconvenience with the sizing.
